💡 TIP: Feeling overwhelmed?

Try the "One-Minute Mindfulness" technique from our Healing Lines collection:

1. Pick one small section of your coloring page
2. Set timer for 1 minute
3. Color slowly and mindfully
4. Take 10 deep breaths
5. Notice how you feel

No pressure to finish. Just be present. 🌿

posts.content: I thought I’d color for five minutes before bed. Just five minutes. Fast-forward two hours: the tea is cold, my hand is cramped, and I’ve spent way too long overthinking the meaning of a single shade of blue. This is why I make coloring books. There’s a whole collection of this kind of work on the site if you’re curious.
